reranking_policy: Raw relevance logits over 40 collapsed titles, including retrieved passage/full-plot evidence and parent series context. No title-specific runtime rules.
selection: Prefer improved top-five coverage without losing previously successful Persian identity checks. The alternate mxbai reranker lost a Persian Edge of Tomorrow match; stitched-sentence evidence lost the Inception hallway match. Neither is the release policy.
limitations: Manual small suites, development-informed selection, no independent academic accuracy claim. Reserved titles are disjoint from development and legacy suites, but questions and labels were authored by the same agent. No inference that all films/scenes are recognized.
